categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including details of land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and ownership particulars. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category.
